lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Thirteen distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is maximal in the mid-torso region and decreases progressively toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second anterior line segment from the shoulder, splitting at the dorsal end. Lines 5 and 6 exhibit a merging topology near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 is truncated, existing only as a short segment in the mid-shoulder. Lines 11, 12, and 13 are abbreviated dashed segments confined to the upper haunch quadrant.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are located on the lateral posterior haunch, vertically stacked with a separation of approximately 1/10th of the torso height.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a single white sub-orbital spot. Two distinct horizontal white bands on the mid-to-lower limbs. Tail terminates in a high-contrast black tip.
